message: Hi, I'm a student with a machine learning certification background. My overall academic average is 73.9% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in Computer Architecture and testing. I want to become a Business Intelligence Analyst. My family can afford at most about USD 1400 per year. I live in Coimbatore. I'm open to anywhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in Computer Architecture and testing

explanation:
This program is ideal because it directly addresses your career goal of becoming a Business Intelligence Analyst by focusing on 'business_information_systems' and 'it_management'. It is also located in Coimbatore, minimizing relocation stress, and its tuition fee ($800) is well within your budget.

This MSc Information Systems program focuses on 'business_information_systems', aligning perfectly with your goal of becoming a Business Intelligence Analyst. While the tuition ($1200) is acceptable, its location in Bengaluru offers excellent job prospects, which you prioritized highly.

The MBA Business Analytics program directly supports your goal of becoming a BI Analyst. Although the tuition ($1450) is near your limit, the focus on business analytics and its location in Delhi provides strong job market exposure, making it a high-value option.

This MTech Data Engineering program is highly relevant as data engineering skills are foundational for BI Analysts. It offers strong technical depth and is located in Hyderabad, a major tech hub known for good job opportunities.

While this program focuses on QA testing (which you mentioned), it has an affordable tuition ($1200) and is located in Mumbai. It provides a solid technical foundation that can be supplemented with BI-specific certifications to pivot toward your desired career path.
